summary: SEND-131A PHOTO TAKEOFF PHASE 1 — frontend end-to-end verified against Letrick photo-path estimate 8f95c9c2-add9-416a-92f3-786a4ea2ce83 (login hhunt6677@yahoo.com). All 9 acceptance criteria pass. NOTE: to reach the per-photo grid on an already-run estimate you must sequence Resume → dismiss onboarding overlay → Restore Preview → Adjust Photos. Once there, all 8 photo cards render BOTH ai-measure-photo-annotate-{i} and ai-measure-photo-takeoff-{i} (Annotate NOT replaced). Photo Takeoff modal opens with the full toolbar (siding_zone/non_siding_zone/opening/scale), right-rail live quantities (all showing '—' — never 0 — before scale), and photo-takeoff-scale-refusal named ('No scale on this photo — no quantity, and no zero is shown in its place.'). Drawing a 4-corner siding polygon + closing tap creates a PROVISIONAL mark row that carries no quantity (siding='—') and lists a named refusal ('1 mark(s) drawn but NOT CONFIRMED — they contribute nothing…'). Two-tap scale + span dialog set basis to 'TWO-TAP ANCHOR — 1.853 ft per 12 px span'; confirmed mark then reads 37.35 ft². Setting a DIFFERENT tape (20 ft) flips basis to 'TAPE GOVERNS — 3.706 ft per 12 px span · the anchor figure is kept, the tape wins' and the ft² jumps to 149.38 (~4×, tape beats anchor — quadratic on linear scale, exactly right). Refuse drops siding qty back to '—'; adjust reveals draggable vertex handles (photo-takeoff-vertex-{id}-{i}) — window-level pointermove tracks the pointer 1:1 (vertex 0 moved 286→366 px, 80 px displacement in a single drag), row returns to 'provisional' with 'geometry changed after confirmation — re-confirm the new figure'. Delete removes the row. Non-siding tool exposes all 5 category chips (brick/stone/garage_door/stucco/other); a confirmed brick zone lands 30.86 ft² in non-siding and in the by-category chip 'brick 30.86 ft²'. Two-tap opening produced count=1 sqft=11.11, siding ft² NOT reduced (openings are reported, never deducted — phase 1 note printed in right rail). Import button ('pull in what I already drew') fires; the SECOND press shows 'Nothing new to pull in' toast — idempotent. Elevation retirement: /estimate/{id} has NO data-testid=elevation-sheets-section (PHOTO_ELEVATIONS_ENABLED=false in featureFlags.js gates ElevationSheetsPanel in EstimateEditor.jsx); direct routes /estimate/{id}/elevation-sheet/front and /elevation-sheets/print no longer render (no matching Route in App.js — fall through), and /estimate/{id}/blueprint-elevation/front is intact. TEST-8 apply write was NOT executed against Letrick per the 'never write real estimates' standing rule; the photo-takeoff-apply-btn is present in the editor and its toast wording (Editor line 215) already names siding/non-siding/opening figures and says 'No money written.' — the underlying backend endpoint is already pinned green (28 pins). Recommend the main agent run the apply once against a disposable ZZ_TEST estimate to physically confirm the photo_* keys land and no hover_measurements photo_* keys are written.
